sar.narrative:
SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY REPORT (SAR) - CASE HHG-011

REGULATORY JURISDICTION: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) / BSA

PART I: SUBJECT INFORMATION & ACCOUNT TOPOLOGY
Primary subject customer ID C11923, operating payment card account C11923-K2. Device profile recorded: 'Unknown Device'. Topological investigation identified a coordinated device nexus: the same hardware/browser signature is shared across 4 distinct payment cards and 4 distinct customer profiles, indicating syndicate compromise.

PART II: SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY SUMMARY & FINANCIAL EXPOSURE
Total identified fraudulent exposure amounts to $131.30 USD. The primary flagged transaction 3583368 occurred on 2016-12-29 06:27:44. Activity exhibits unauthorized electronic card-not-present exploitation under pattern classification 'card_testing'.

PART III: CHRONOLOGY & TYPOLOGY PATTERN MECHANICS
Initial alert triggered via customer_report ('Customer C11923 message: 'I never made this $131.30 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3583368.'). Velocity analysis revealed 0 transaction(s) within the 1-hour window and 0 within 24 hours (velocity spike ratio: 0.0).

PART IV: INVESTIGATIVE FINDINGS, GRAPH EVIDENCE & POLICIES CITED
Cardholder was contacted via out-of-band verification and affirmed: 'Cardholder provided response for analyst_info under scenario denies'. Graph traversal confirmed pattern typology 'card_testing'. Filing is mandated pursuant to Bank Fraud Policy Section 3a (Confirmed Unauthorized Fraud), Policy Rule R2 (Customer Disavowal), and Policy Rule R6 (Syndicate Multi-Card Compromise).

PART V: ACTIONS TAKEN & RECOMMENDED DISPOSITION
The financial institution has immediately blocked payment card C11923-K2, declined pending authorizations, and placed all connected accounts and shared devices under enhanced automated surveillance. This case is referred to law enforcement and FinCEN for coordinated syndicate interdiction.
